title: Angles as Turns
summary: Quarter, half and full turns, degrees, right, acute and obtuse angles, and directions.

cbse.chapter: Maths Mela (2025) Ch 3: Angles as Turns

objectives: I can describe turns as fractions of a full turn.
I can measure turns in degrees.
I can name acute, right and obtuse angles.
misconceptions: Longer arms make a bigger angle.
A right angle must point to the right.
